Standard: The parking brake system prevents inadvertent activation by the flight crew. The on-off status of the parking brake is indicated to the flight crew. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review cockpit controls and placement to verify inadvertent activation is prevented. Demonstration.
  (1) Conduct ground demonstration to verify indication system informs the flight crew if system is activated. Parking brake engages and disengages when flight crew input command is given or automatically based on control system inputs (e.g., advancing throttles above set point). Test.
    (1) Lab test: Simulator testing verifies system design logic, indication, and function of parking brake.
